title: Petite camusette (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Petite camusette. 6 voices (Superius, Quintus, Contratenor, Tenor, Sextus, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos3007); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
